# Direct state writes outside internal/state. TestStateWritesGoThroughHelper fails on
# any write that is not listed here, and on a line whose count is now too high.
# Format: <violation|not-state> <file> <func> <count> [# reason]
# violation: state written directly today. These lines may only shrink: move the write
#   behind internal/state, then run the test with -update (it never adds a line).
# not-state: files that are not shared Dyna state. Each needs a reason.
